// Synchronous ROM Module
module origen_115565 #(
    parameter romVals = "truthtable8.txt",
    parameter addr_width = 8,
    parameter data_width = 8
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire [addr_width-1:0] addr,
    output reg [data_width-1:0] data
);

    reg [data_width-1:0] rom [0:(2**addr_width)-1];
    
    initial begin
        $readmemh(romVals, rom);
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        data <= rom[addr];
    end

endmodule

// Testbench
module sync_rom_tb;

    reg clk;
    reg [7:0] addr;
    wire [7:0] data;
    
    sync_rom #(
        .romVals("truthtable8.txt"),
        .addr_width(8),
        .data_width(8)
    ) dut (
        .clk(clk),
        .addr(addr),
        .data(data)
    );
    
    // Clock generation
    always #50 clk = ~clk;
    
    initial begin
        clk = 0;
        addr = 0;
        
        // Read all ROM locations
        repeat (256) begin
            @(posedge clk);
            addr = addr + 1;
        end
        
        $finish;
    end
    
    // Optional: Add monitoring for visualization
    initial begin
        $monitor("Time=%0t, Address=%h, Data=%h", $time, addr, data);
    end

endmodule
